name: Sensor Defeat
description: When sensor avoidance is not possible, active defeat techniques can suppress alarm activation. REX sensors can be triggered intentionally to hold a door lock released. Solenoid-based sensors may respond to magnetic interference. PIR sensors can sometimes be defeated by moving very slowly or by thermal masking. Each technique requires specific knowledge of the sensor type and must be validated against the exact variant encountered.

blue.det: Alarm activation if defeat attempt fails; tampering with sensor housing detectable during inspection; motion near sensors without activation may indicate defeat.
blue.cm: Dual-technology sensors (PIR + microwave) cannot be defeated with static objects; tamper-evident sensor housings; supervised alarm zones alerting on sensor disconnection; regular sensor testing.
